_README: TEMPLATE / PLACEHOLDER — copy to {TICKER}.json (uppercase ticker) and replace every value with figures TRANSCRIBED BY THE OPERATOR from the issuer's AUDITED ANNUAL REPORT. This file is the local-manual fundamentals adapter for names NOT on SEC EDGAR (e.g. GCC issuers on the DFM/ADX: DEWA, TABREED, EMPOWER, TALABAT). There is NO free, reliable structured API for those exchanges, and Owlfolio is fail-closed/local-first — so their primary data is an operator data-entry step, not a scrape. DO NOT fabricate figures. The resolver skips any file whose ticker starts with '_', so this template is never resolved as a real name.
_units: All *_musd fields are in MILLIONS of the document `currency` (e.g. for AED, a value of 1000 means AED 1,000,000,000 = 1bn). All *_m share counts are in MILLIONS of shares. `diluted_shares_m` should be the weighted-average DILUTED share count for the fiscal year. Use the SAME currency the financial statements are presented in.
_currency_caveat: The backtest values OE-per-share (in this currency) against a market price. The price MUST be quoted in the SAME currency (the local listing), never a USD ADR — otherwise OE_ps and price are mixed currencies and the verdict is meaningless.
entity_name: Full legal entity name (e.g. National Central Cooling Company PJSC (Tabreed))

source.note: Operator-entered from the audited consolidated financial statements (income statement + balance sheet + cash-flow statement) in the FY2024 annual report. `filed` is the report publication date used as the backtest as-of date.
